findings.reason: the §7 node should have the ingest own both the node write and the edge merge (making the ordering a property of one owner) rather than adding a second inline write that a future edit can desynchronise.
findings.text: §7's fix writes the DataAccess node with a fresh inline Cypher `MERGE` in `seed_worker` instead of extending `ingest_discovered_signals` (same file, line 2280), which already owns the phase-2 `DATA_ACCESS` edge merge that the write must precede; the node write now sits in three places in one file (MDSplus branch, non-MDSplus branch, edge phase) and the ordering invariant is held by placement rather than by one owner

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — each new mechanism hides its behaviour behind one small interface: `resolve_remote_environment` (`imas_codex/remote/environment.py:63`) hides the facility-block/data-system override precedence behind one call; §8 makes `resolve_service_url` (`imas_codex/remote/locations.py:206`) the one owner of SLURM service discovery behind one function; §3 adds one `fronts_database` property and reuses the existing edge writer rather than spreading new wrappers.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §7 leaves two owners of the DataAccess node write inside the signal pipeline: `seed_worker` adds a second inline `MERGE (da:DataAccess {id: $id})` beside the MDSplus one it already carries, while `ingest_discovered_signals` (`imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2280`) owns the phase-2 `DATA_ACCESS` edge merge the write exists to satisfy.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §2 accounts for its three typed slots and `SignalDataClass` enum by retiring the prototype's `class:`/`shots:`/`udpid:` keyword parking, §3 states `fronts_database` "retires nothing, because no existing WikiPage property records the database a rendered page is backed by", §6 retires `data_access_patterns.setup_commands` and states "no new CLI command is added" and "no refusal family is added", and §8 adds "no public definition ... two private discovery copies plus one rewrite are removed".
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the plan searched the two codebases it names and cites the mechanisms it extends or retires: the TDI/PPF/JPF/MDSplus scanners in `imas_codex/discovery/signals/`, the existing `WikiChunk-[:DOCUMENTS]->FacilitySignal` writer `link_chunks_to_entities` in `imas_codex/discovery/wiki/pipeline.py:252`, `DataSystemBase` plus `data_access_patterns.setup_commands` in `imas_codex/schemas/facility_config.yaml`, `get_python_status`/`check_all_tools` in `imas_codex/remote/python.py` and `imas_codex/remote/tools.py`, `seed_worker` in `imas_codex/discovery/signals/parallel.py:2360`, and the four `resolve_service_url`-family copies in §8.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — every section that layers over existing machinery states why the machinery is extended rather than wrapped: §3 gains `fronts_database` as one more key on `link_chunks_to_entities` and keeps `WikiPageStatus` a closed enum; §6 extends `get_python_status`/`check_all_tools` and adds no CLI command ("its `missing_required`/`version_too_old` verdict raised at the start of a scan"); §8 retires copies rather than wrapping them.
